summary: Iteration 23 — WLADHUB Pricing Overhaul (Leadership OS / OS PLUS / Enterprise). Backend: 26/26 pytest cases passed (enterprise calc tiers, inquiry POST + persistence + validation, all 4 Stripe checkout packages with correct amounts, old packages return 400). Frontend: full E2E flow on /close passed — 3 plan tiles render with correct testids, no old Starter/Fast Track/6970 references, payment-option toggles update Stripe CTA price (997/2x550/12x99), OS PLUS shows 4.447 EUR with NO toggle, enterprise calculator updates pricing live for all 6 tiers (5/10/20/50/100/200 → 10/15/20/30/40/50%), enterprise inquiry form validates + submits + shows ent-inq-success, empty form shows ent-inq-error.

issues: Body copy contains 'Wert pro Kurs: 199 EUR' which references the same number as the legacy Starter 199€ price. Not a bug per spec (this is course-value marketing copy, not a price tier), but flagged for stakeholder confirmation that the 199 EUR per-course wording is intentional and not a leftover.

critical_code_review_comments: Legacy alias 'standard_yearly' still exists in PACKAGES (payments.py line 21) — fine for backward compat but consider removal once frontend cache window expires.

Backend POST /api/enterprise/inquire validates company/contact_name/email but does not strip-validate empty strings post-Pydantic (e.g. ' ' would pass). Frontend already guards this client-side, but a server-side `.strip()` length check would be safer.
HighTicketClose.jsx is 633 lines — close to the 700-line guideline; PAYMENT_OPTIONS, ENTERPRISE_TIERS and feature lists could be extracted to /constants.

calc_enterprise_discount duplicates tier definitions between backend (admin.py) and frontend (HighTicketClose.jsx). Single source of truth via /enterprise/calculate is recommended for future-proofing tier changes.

Webhook flow (POST /api/webhook/stripe) creates license keys with plan=tx['plan'] which now correctly maps to leader_os / leader_os_plus — verified via PACKAGES metadata. No live webhook fired during testing (Stripe test-mode); covered indirectly via tx-record assertions.
seed_data_creation: Created several TEST_-prefixed enterprise inquiries via /api/enterprise/inquire and TEST_ Stripe payment_transactions during checkout-creation tests. All clearly tagged with TEST_ prefix for cleanup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Pricing overhaul (iter23) is fully validated end-to-end. Backend test file `/app/backend/tests/test_pricing_overhaul_iter23.py` is reusable as regression. Stripe checkout amounts and metadata persistence verified. Webhook -> license_key flow not exercised live (would require Stripe webhook simulation); recommend simulating CheckoutStatusResponse POST in next iteration if license key issuance for new plans needs explicit verification.
